business.title: Crusoe investor bets on solar and batteries for AI data centers
business.summary: Next-generation data centers will need tens of gigawatts of power yearly, prompting investments in solar and energy storage.
business.why: Power availability and infrastructure costs are primary bottlenecks for scaling future AI data centers.

business.title: Dell earnings beat on AI strength with $25 billion buyback
business.summary: Dell's overall sales more than doubled annually during the third quarter, driven by strong AI server demand.
business.why: Hardware vendor earnings provide concrete metrics on enterprise AI deployment scale and spending.

business.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million data center satellites
business.summary: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites for the Starmind initiative, marking the first agency approval for space-based data centers.
business.why: Orbital data centers represent an emerging infrastructure frontier for compute-heavy workloads.

business.title: Tech stocks sink as investors weigh AI spending and inflation risks
business.summary: Nvidia and other AI-linked stocks fell as investors weighed AI spending, inflation, and higher-rate risks.
business.why: Market volatility directly impacts funding conditions and valuations across the AI industry.

business.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, threatening startup valuations
business.summary: Anthropic's post-IPO slump could put pressure on AI startup valuations as market confidence fluctuates.
business.why: Public market performance sets benchmarks for private AI startup exits and funding rounds.

business.title: Amazon in talks to end Muse AI shopping block with Meta
business.summary: Amazon held talks about letting Meta's Muse AI agent shop on its marketplace, centering on product recommendations and advertising revenue impact.
business.why: Ecosystem gatekeeping and agentic commerce integrations shape the future of AI shopping platforms.

business.title: Investigators question Nvidia over chip destinations and executive relationship
business.summary: Investigators are examining what Nvidia knew about where Megaspeed chips ended up and whether an executive relationship gave reason to doubt assurances.
business.why: Regulatory and compliance scrutiny can pose operational and legal risks for major hardware providers.

business.title: Vance says Jensen Huang was not under DOJ investigation
business.summary: Questions arose regarding whether the Trump administration investigated Jensen Huang for potential national security risks.
business.why: Political and regulatory oversight can influence major AI hardware leadership and strategy.

business.title: Startup exit terms and early contracts shape future valuations
business.summary: Financing terms and contracts for compute, data, and distribution set early can slow sales, add costs, and erode value later.
business.why: Founders must carefully negotiate initial agreements to protect long-term startup value.

business.title: Crunchbase estimates unicorn valuations reach $11 trillion
business.summary: While 1,900 startups on the Crunchbase Unicorn Board have a combined valuation of roughly $9 trillion, a new model puts private-company values closer to $11 trillion.
business.why: Private market valuation trends give context to overall venture capital health in the AI sector.
